reason: Korea Manhwa Museum (한국만화박물관, KOMACON-run, Bucheon). The museum's komacon.kr/comicsmuseum library pages point to its OWN digital archive 만화규장각 / KMAS (https://www.kmas.or.kr) — robots Allow:/, sitemap present. KMAS tags every holding with a category chip <span class="collection_mark">; the in-scope ORIGINAL FLAT ART is 원화 (original comic-art boards). List route GET /original/mainCollectionList?dtaSe1Cd=10&pageIndex=N enumerates them (dtaSe1Cd=10==원화, =30==연속간행물/printed books which are out of scope); 8 items/page; total surfaced via '총 N건' = 41 원화 objects by 34 named manhwa masters (이두호·김성환·신문수·길창덕·박재동·강철수·김종래·신동헌 등). Detail route /original/mainCollectionList/{d1}/{d2}/{relicId} gives title (collection_tit), artist (collection_author), 제작연도/크기/유물번호, and a swiper gallery of full images. CRITICAL copyright check passed: the public full-image endpoint /common/file/atchmnDownload.ajax?type=collection&fileImageId={uuid} returns the UNMARKED full-res master (verified 2751x3884, Canon EOS scan, ~11MB) with NO login and NO watermark, fetched clean-room with no cookies (HTTP 200). The watermarked variant atchmnDownloadMark.ajax 403s for us and the thumb endpoint is 300px — neither is used. The gated /original/collectionDigiFile '디지털파일 제공' service (login+신청+허가조건) is a SEPARATE path and is NOT used. Probe ran 15 objects end-to-end (list→detail parse→full-image download→600px gate→webp→R2 upload) with 0 image errors. Metadata fill across all 41: artist 41/41, title 41/41, dimensions 41/41, year 25/41 — the missing year is a verified SITE GAP (제작연도 field exists but is left blank; no hidden year in JSON-LD/alt fields), not a parser bug. Under the min-4 rule (title/artist/year/category mandatory) the final in-scope count is 25; 16 are dropped solely for a blank production year.
easy_source_found: NO public bulk dump / open JSON API for original art. KMAS DOES publish an 'Open API' (/openapi/search/dcmtDtaList, /openapi/search/bookAndWebtoonList, JSON, imageDownloadUrl) BUT it (a) requires a real-name-verified account + application + 24h ADMIN APPROVAL for the 인증키, and (b) covers webtoon/books/films only — NO 원화 (original-art) endpoint. So the Open API is unusable for our scope. The usable source is KMAS public HTML on the museum's own infra (kmas.or.kr): server-rendered list pages (?dtaSe1Cd=10&pageIndex=N) + detail pages, with the open unmarked full-image endpoint /common/file/atchmnDownload.ajax. dml.komacon.kr does not resolve (DNS/connection fails).
probe_summary: node scripts/scrape-korea-manhwa.mjs --probe → enumerated 41 원화 objects, processed first 15 end-to-end with 0 image errors; 5 cleared min-4 and were written to public/data/korea-manhwa-collection-probe.json with real R2 webp images (e.g. 정운경 — 왈순 아지매 (1997), 270x195mm, drawing). The other 10 were dropped because KMAS leaves 제작연도 blank for them (verified site gap). Full-res unmarked masters confirmed downloadable (2751x3884) and 600px gate passes easily.

exhibitions_entry.name: Korea Manhwa Museum
exhibitions_entry.description: Korea's first and largest museum dedicated to manhwa (Korean comics), run by the Korea Manhwa Content Agency (KOMACON) in Bucheon. Its collection preserves original hand-drawn comic-art boards (원화) by the masters who built modern Korean comics — from Kim Song-hwan's 'Wae Sun Ajimae' and Sin Mun-su's 'Dokkaebi Gamtu' to Lee Doo-ho, Gil Chang-deok and Park Jae-dong — alongside an extensive archive of comics, magazines and animation. The original-art holdings are digitized at full resolution in the museum's 만화규장각 (KMAS) archive.
exhibitions_entry.description_ko: 한국 최초이자 최대 규모의 만화 전문 박물관으로, 부천에 자리한 한국만화영상진흥원(KOMACON)이 운영한다. 김성환의 「왈순 아지매」, 신문수의 「도깨비 감투」를 비롯해 이두호·길창덕·박재동 등 한국 만화를 일군 거장들의 손그림 원고(원화)를 소장하고 있으며, 만화·잡지·애니메이션 자료까지 폭넓게 아우른다. 원화 소장품은 박물관이 운영하는 만화규장각(KMAS)에 고해상도로 디지털화되어 있다.

notes: Source = KMAS public HTML (museum-own infra). dtaSe1Cd=10 isolates 원화; books (=30) excluded by category chip, not guesswork. Each object is a multi-page board set (3–6 images); scraper uses the first gallery image as the representative board (one ARMIN record/object, matching the one-image schema). All categorized 'drawing' (hand-drawn boards). DECISION POINT for --full: with year mandatory, final = 25 records (clean min-4). If the operator wants the full 41 (16 have blank 제작연도 but are otherwise complete, image-rich original art by famous artists), relax the year requirement for this collection only — recommend keeping all 41 given the small, high-value corpus and 100% dimensions/artist/title fill, with year left empty where the site omits it. Coordinates: 길주로 1, 원미구, 부천 (Line 7 Samsan-cheyukgwan stn exit 5); WGS84 ~37.5047,126.7544. Open API exists but needs admin-approved key and has no 원화 endpoint (see easy_source_found). DO NOT run --full per instructions.
